	location:$MARKET$.market ?= {
		"merchant_power_in_market(root)" >= {
			value = total_merchant_power
			multiply = $SHARE$
		}
	}
}

	OR = {
		AND = {
			oe_wp35_bri_is_britain = yes
			has_variable = $FLAG$

		AND = {
			oe_wp35_bri_oe_wp35_is_british_india = yes

				oe_wp35_bri_is_britain = yes
				has_variable = $FLAG$
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_wp35_bri_eligible_seller = {
	exists = capital
	capital.sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
	scope:actor = { has_discovered = prev.capital }
	NOT = { this = scope:actor }
	NOR = {
		country_type = building
		country_type = pop
	}
	oe_wp35_bri_participant = no
	NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = scope:actor }
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { is_subject = yes }
		overlord ?= {
			oe_wp35_bri_participant = no
			exists = capital
			capital.sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
		}
	}
	NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
}

oe_wp35_bri_madras_candidate = {
	oe_wp35_bri_grantable_coast = yes
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			location:madras = { oe_wp35_bri_grantable_coast = yes owner ?= { oe_wp35_bri_willing_seller = yes } }
		}
		this = location:madras
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = {
			area:tamil_land_area = {
				any_location_in_area = {
					oe_wp35_bri_grantable_coast = yes
					owner ?= { oe_wp35_bri_willing_seller = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		area = area:tamil_land_area
	}
	trigger_else = {
		always = yes
	}
}
